title: Unrivaled in Another World With a High-Spec Beautiful Girl Secretary via the Disadvantaged Skill “Patent Right”! ~If You Want to Use the Strongest Magic Monopolized by Me, a Mob Hero, I Will Be Taking Patent Licensing Fees~
description:
The skill granted in another world was... "Patent Right"?!

Otaku high school student Yuma Kujo is transported to another world along with his entire class. Hoping that "If it's another world, I should be able to dominate with a cheat skill...!", what he is given instead is the mysterious skill "Patent Right".

Not knowing how to use the skill, his classmates judge him useless in combat and abandon him.

Appearing before Yuma is the high-spec beautiful girl secretary, Iris! Guided by her, he discovers the true power of his skill: he can monopolize whatever ultimate magic he invents?!

Rising from the bottom with a disadvantaged skill! A magic invention and monopolization peerless fantasy!
author: Kizuka Maya
